name: Wing Umbra
description: Strike with one arm swept out like a wing and a thin umbra trailing behind it.

name: Pinion Murk
description: Turn a cut aside with the off arm lifted as the second wing and a haze of murk about it.

name: Wingbeat Dusk
description: Step in two quick beats like a bird hopping so the dim keeps pace with the body.

name: Folded Gloam
description: Fold both wings of gloom across the chest and hold them as a close layered guard.

name: Spread Shroud
description: Spread both wings wide to throw a shroud over the foes that dims the light and the edge of things.

name: Pinion Lash
description: Beat one wing across and then the other so two lashes of dark land in quick turn.

name: Winged Pall
description: Beat both wings out together and send a flat pall of dark over the ground before the user.

name: Wing Rend
description: Draw both wings to a point and drive them through a guard as a single narrow spear.

name: Dark Wingfall
description: Lift both wings high through the qi field and drop them over the foes in a vast and heavy fall.

name: Wings Closing
description: The school's closing stroke; both wings fold over the foe at once and crush what lies between them.

name: Umbra Edge
description: Cut with the edge of the hand in a plain court stroke that carries a thin umbra.

name: Rebuke Murk
description: Meet a blow with a forearm and rebuke it sideways in a spreading smear of murk.

name: Gavel Hush
description: Cross the floor with the measured step of a court in session and the sound muffled.

name: Bench Shadow
description: Lay the shadow of the bench on one foe so that he stands in judgement and cannot rise.

name: Rule Gloom
description: Hold a dark rule across the front that blows may not pass without leave.

name: Charge Cut
description: Bring the hand down in a cut that names the foe's fault and drives the dark into the guard.

name: Silencing Dark
description: Stop a foe's call or chant with a plug of dark laid over the mouth and the qi behind it.

name: Judging Pall
description: Draw a pall over the whole floor of the fight until the foes can see only the court's judge.

name: Gavel Stroke
description: Deliver the verdict as one heavy stroke that falls where the dark has already marked the foe.

name: Sealing Verdict
description: Hold a full court of dark through the qi field and seal a foe's body and technique in it.

name: Sentence Passed
description: The school's sealing judgement; the sentence falls on a bound foe and the dark finishes the stroke.

name: Dusk Ribbon
description: Flick a thin ribbon of dusk from the fingers like water thrown from a stream.

name: Silt Shade
description: Raise a bank of slow silt-dark that stops a thrust and settles back after it.

name: Stream Step
description: Step along a thread of dark that carries the body forward as a stream carries a leaf.

name: Guard Stream
description: Run one stream of dark round the body in a ring and let it carry blows around.

name: Strike Stream
description: Run the second stream down the arm into the fist so the blow lands with its whole flow.

name: Parting Flow
description: Split a foe's own qi flow with a wedge of dark so it runs two ways and weakens.

name: Confluence Black
description: Bring the two streams together over the ground in a single wide churn of black.

name: Deep Pool
description: Open a deep pool of dark under a foe and let him sink to the waist and stick there.

name: Pent Flood
description: Loose the pent streams through the qi field and send a roaring flood of dark over the ground.

name: Streams Meeting
description: The school's closing stroke; guard stream and strike stream meet at one point and break upon the foe.

name: Core Umbra
description: Draw a thin umbra up from the core into the fist and strike with it.

name: Dark Stoop
description: Rise and drop a short span on a dark updraft as the court hawk stoops.

name: Hawk Veil
description: Throw the hawk's veil about the shoulders to blunt a cut and hide the shape beneath.

name: Core Gloam
description: Seat a coal of gloom in the core and let it lend depth to every move of the day.

name: Talon Plunge
description: Dive from a height with the core's weight behind the fist and the eclipse's shadow ahead.

name: Penumbra Cast
description: Cast the court's eclipse over a small ground so the sky above the foes goes dark.

name: Gloam Ward
description: Hold a ward of dark drawn from the core that does not tire like a ward of mere qi.

name: Hawk Hunger
description: Hang the hawk's hunger over one foe like a shadow until his limbs stiffen with dread.

name: Eclipse Talon
description: Drive a talon of eclipse-dark through a guard and into the weak point behind it.

name: Lowering Sky
description: Bring a canopy of eclipse down over a wide ground and press it low on all within.

name: Core Eclipse
description: Make the core the heart of an eclipse and let its dark bear down on the whole ground.

name: Hawk Lowers Eclipse
description: The school's closing stroke; the hawk lowers the eclipse on a foe and the dark holds him down.

name: Gust Dim
description: Blow a gust of dim across a foe's face so the world loses its edges for a breath.

name: Sworn Black
description: Throw a blow wrapped in black along a single sworn line that does not bend.

name: Breeze Hide
description: Draw the wind in close with the dark so the body moves unheard on the air.

name: Dim Bearing
description: Take a bearing by the dim edge of the light and cross a wide space in a single run.

name: Gale Shroud
description: Wear a shroud of dark that the wind keeps moving so no blow finds the same place twice.

name: Oathbound Cut
description: Cut along the sworn bearing in a stroke that ends only where the oath says.

name: Dimming Gale
description: Raise a gale heavy with dark that blows across the ground and dims all it touches.

name: Oath Press
description: Press an oath of dark on a foe until he cannot lift a hand against the wind.

name: Black Squall
description: Call a black squall through the qi field and let it break over the foes without mercy.

name: Sworn Dimming
description: The school's closing stroke; the sworn blow lands out of a sudden dimming that the foe never sees.

name: Oath Pall
description: Draw a light pall about the body under oath and feel its weight settle on the next blows.

name: Bound Palm
description: Strike with a palm bound in pall so the blow cannot be recalled once it starts.

name: Pall Guard
description: Draw the pall across the arm to take a blow and give it back as a dull push.

name: Thickening Pall
description: Let the pall thicken round one foe a little each breath until he bends under it.

name: Oathbound Pall
description: Hold the pall as a bare wall with no gate and an oath that nothing passes it.

name: Pall Cut
description: Cut through the pall so the blow comes out of the thickest dark ahead of the foe.

name: Pall Mesh
description: Draw the pall in about a foe like a net pulled slowly shut.

name: Leaden Vow
description: Pour the whole weight of the oath into the pall and bear every foe in it down.

name: Pall Collapse
description: Let the pall fall in on itself in one blow that crushes all within its bounds.

name: Sworn Smother
description: Smother a foe's qi flow with the sworn pall through the qi field until it cannot move.

name: Oath Not Recalled
description: The school's closing stroke; the oath is spoken in the pall and the blow that follows cannot be turned.

name: Bare Black
description: Throw a plain black bolt along a clear line with nothing to hide it or the thrower.

name: Open Shroud
description: Throw the shroud wide to take a thrust on its open fold and let it slide off.

name: Bannered Stride
description: Stride out into plain view with the dark thrown behind like a banner.

name: Black Reach
description: Stretch the dark out along the bearing and strike at a foe beyond arm's length.

name: Lit Bare
description: Strip a foe's veil of dim and leave him lit and plain before the whole dark.

name: Open Weight
description: Lay the dark's whole weight on a foe in the open and let him find no cover from it.

name: Wide Black
description: Spread the black in one broad sheet over the front so that every foe is touched.

name: Bearing Crush
description: Bring the black down along the bearing in a single crushing stroke on a chosen foe.

name: Black Eclipse
description: Open a full black expanse through the qi field that leaves no shelter anywhere inside it.

name: Blackfall
description: The school's closing stroke; the whole black falls in a single plain blow with nothing held back.

name: Snuff Umbra
description: Strike with a palm that snuffs the glow on whatever it touches.

name: Ember Quell
description: Beat aside a spark or a bolt of bright qi and quell it as it passes.

name: Ashen Step
description: Step over fallen embers and leave them cold with the dark trailing the heel.

name: Cold Core
description: Turn the core cold and dark inside the chest so its qi runs steady and quiet.

name: Quenching Core
description: Pull the heat and glow from a foe's core with a patient grip of dark.

name: Cinder Pall
description: Hold a grey veil that dims what strikes it until the blow is spent.

name: Dying Light
description: Dim every glow of qi in reach to the last flicker and break the foe's rhythm.

name: Final Ember
description: Strike at the last flicker of a foe's qi and finish it where it still burns.

name: Last Lamp
description: Close the dark over the last lamp or glow in a foe's technique and seal it shut.

name: Ashfall
description: Rain grey dark over the ground until every small light and fire in it lies cold.

name: Core Extinction
description: Gather the dark in the formed core and snuff every glow of qi across the field.

name: Sworn Extinction Stroke
description: The school's closing stroke; the sworn dark puts out the last light of a foe in one breath.
